lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice softening opinions with kanske, nog, and det beror på.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues compare possible plans when they are not fully sure.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Expressing uncertainty and mild disagreement politely.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether to eat out, take a walk, or stay in, but the best choice depends on time and weather.

main_focus.name: softened opinions with modal adverbs
main_focus.description: Use kanske, nog, and det beror på to make opinions and decisions less direct.
model_examples: Jag tror nog att det blir bättre imorgon.
Det beror på hur sent det blir.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use a softening phrase naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use uncertainty chunks to make the exchange sound natural and cooperative.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person suggests a simple plan.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss uncertainty, constraints, and a mild difference in preference.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose a flexible option or postpone the decision.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat softened opinion phrases with different reasons

sentence_focus: one sentence with jag tror nog att
one sentence with det beror på
one sentence choosing one option over another with hellre
